product.title: E-Bike Guided Tour in Boulder, Colorado

description.text: Enjoy an active introduction to Boulder, Colorado—and discover many of the city’s top attractions—on this small-group e-bike tour. Pick from multiple convenient, daily start times; meet your guide in central Boulder; and get acquainted with your e-bike. Stops include Folsom Field, Fiske Planetarium, Hotel Boulderado, Boulder County Farmers Market, University of Colorado at Boulder, The Hill. Then, follow your guide to local landmarks like Wonderland Lake Park, the University of Colorado at Boulder, the Flatirons, and much more. Ideal for visitors basing in Boulder who want a guided Front Range experience without coordinating meeting points, trailheads, or photo locations on their own.
